notes: Card: ' b' x12, ' B' x10, 'B' x3, 'b' x2, in boulders, Bishops, bhasya. Probe: boulders 0.74, Bishops 0.74, but bhasya 0.13 and Bistro 0.08 (same split), so a general 'split-off b' label is not claimed. Rocks, Elders, commentary at most 0.04. Tokenizer checked.
